Accordion.signature: Accordion(items: {title: string, content?: any[]}[], type?: "single" | "multiple", className?: string)
Accordion.description: Vertically stacked collapsible sections. items:[{title,content?}]. First item open by default.

Alert.signature: Alert(title: string, description?: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive", className?: string)
Alert.description: Inline callout box with a title and optional description. variant 'destructive' for errors.

AlertDialog.signature: AlertDialog(title: string, description?: string, actionLabel?: string, cancelLabel?: string, actionVariant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link", size?: "default" | "sm", triggerLabel?: string, className?: string)
AlertDialog.description: Confirmation modal with a title, description, cancel and action buttons. Open by default in preview. size 'sm' for compact.

ArticlePreview.signature: ArticlePreview(heading?: string, featured?: {title: string, excerpt?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}, articles?: {title: string, excerpt?: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
ArticlePreview.description: Article preview: featured article + grid of recent articles. For blogs, news, publications.

AspectRatio.signature: AspectRatio(children?: any[], ratio?: number, className?: string)
AspectRatio.description: Box that constrains its children to a fixed width/height ratio (e.g. ratio 1.778 for 16:9).

Avatar.signature: Avatar(fallback: string, src?: string, alt?: string, size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg", className?: string)
Avatar.description: Circular user avatar. `src` image with `fallback` initials shown when no image. size sm|default|lg.

AvatarGroup.signature: AvatarGroup(items: {fallback: string, src?: string, alt?: string}[], overflow?: string, size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg", className?: string)
AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping cluster of avatars. `items` each {fallback, src?, alt?}; optional `overflow` shows a +N count chip.

Badge.description: Small status/label pill. Mirrors shadcn variant.

BentoGrid.signature: BentoGrid(heading?: string, cells?: {title: string, description?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, span?: "wide" | "tall" | "normal"}[], layout?: "2-lg-3" | "2-lg-4" | "2-md-4" | "1-md-2-3" | "1-md-2-4" | "1-md-3" | "1-sm-2" | "1-sm-2-lg-3", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
BentoGrid.description: Bento grid: asymmetric cells of varying sizes. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono figure indices + ghost numerals + tick bars), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows).

BlogPost.signature: BlogPost(title?: string, author?: string, date?: string, readTime?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, excerpt?: string, sections?: {heading: string, body: string}[], pullQuote?: string, authorBio?: string, authorImageAlt?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
BlogPost.description: Blog post layout: hero image + article title + meta (author, date, read time) + body paragraphs with headings + pull quote + author bio card. For individual blog posts, articles, news stories.

BookingForm.signature: BookingForm(heading?: string, subheading?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
BookingForm.description: Booking form: heading + form with name/date/time/party-size fields. For reservations, appointments.

Box.description: Generic container div. Use `className` for arbitrary Tailwind styling.

Breadcrumb.signature: Breadcrumb(items?: {label: string, href?: string}[], className?: string)
Breadcrumb.description: Hierarchical breadcrumb trail. `items` is ordered root -> current; the last item is the current page.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link", size?: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg", className?: string)

ButtonGroup.signature: ButtonGroup(children?: any[], leadingText?: string, trailingText?: string, orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical", className?: string)
ButtonGroup.description: Segmented control that visually joins adjacent Buttons. children are the buttons; orientation horizontal (default) or vertical.

ButtonGroupDivider.description: Separator placed between items inside a ButtonGroup.

Calendar.signature: Calendar(mode?: "single" | "multiple" | "range", captionLayout?: "label" | "dropdown" | "dropdown-months" | "dropdown-years", buttonVariant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link", numberOfMonths?: number, showOutsideDays?: boolean, showWeekNumber?: boolean, className?: string)
Calendar.description: Month-grid date picker (react-day-picker). Renders a static month with a sample selection. mode 'single' | 'multiple' | 'range'.

Card.signature: Card(children?: any[], title?: string, description?: string, footer?: any[], className?: string)
Card.description: Bordered content container with optional title, description, body (children) and footer.

CardGrid.signature: CardGrid(eyebrow?: string, heading?: string, subheading?: string, cards?: {title: string, description?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, variant?: "standard" | "collapsed-border" | "asymmetric", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, watermark?: string, decor?: "none" | "dot-grid" | "graph-paper" | "glow", className?: string, design?: string)
CardGrid.description: Section with eyebrow + heading + grid of cards. Each card has an optional index, title, and description. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices + tick bars), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows), terminal (mono $ labels), editorial (serif + figure indices).

Carousel.signature: Carousel(slides?: any[][], orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical", basis?: "full" | "half" | "third", className?: string)
Carousel.description: Sliding carousel with previous/next arrows. Each `slides` entry is one slide's content. `basis` controls slides-per-view.

CategoryNav.signature: CategoryNav(heading?: string, categories?: {name: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, className?: string, design?: string)
CategoryNav.description: Category navigation: grid of category tiles with name and optional image. Links to pages.

CenteredHero.signature: CenteredHero(heading?: string, subheading?: string, primaryCta?: string, secondaryCta?: string, stats?: {value: string, label: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
CenteredHero.description: Centered hero: display heading + lead text + CTA + optional stats row. Clean, versatile, works for any landing page.

Chart.signature: Chart(data?: {label: string, value: number}[], kind?: "area" | "bar" | "line", label?: string, className?: string)
Chart.description: Static SVG chart from data:[{label,value}]. kind 'area' (default), 'bar', or 'line'. Ships sample data so it renders standalone.

Checkbox.signature: Checkbox(label?: string, defaultChecked?: boolean, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Checkbox.description: Checkbox with optional inline label. Mirrors shadcn Checkbox.

Collapsible.signature: Collapsible(label: string, children?: any[], className?: string)
Collapsible.description: Single show/hide region with a clickable trigger label. Open by default. children is the collapsible body.

Combobox.signature: Combobox(items?: {value: string, label: string}[], placeholder?: string, emptyMessage?: string, className?: string)
Combobox.description: Searchable select: type to filter `items`. `placeholder` labels the empty input. Open by default for preview.

ComingSoonHero.signature: ComingSoonHero(heading?: string, subheading?: string, cta?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
ComingSoonHero.description: Coming soon hero: ghost-stroke display heading + lead + email waitlist form. Urgency-driven, minimal.

Command.signature: Command(groups?: {heading?: string, items: {label: string, shortcut?: string, disabled?: boolean}[]}[], placeholder?: string, emptyText?: string, className?: string)
Command.description: Searchable command palette rendered inline. groups:[{heading, items:[{label,shortcut}]}]. Shows a search box + grouped, selectable items.

ComparisonTable.signature: ComparisonTable(heading?: string, columns?: string[], rows?: {feature: string, values: string[]}[], className?: string, design?: string)
ComparisonTable.description: Comparison table: rows of features compared across columns. For feature comparisons, specs.

ContactForm.signature: ContactForm(heading?: string, subheading?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
ContactForm.description: Contact form: heading + form with name/email/message fields. Optional contact info beside.

ContentTabs.signature: ContentTabs(heading?: string, tabs?: {label: string, content: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
ContentTabs.description: Content tabs: tabbed sections with label + content. For feature切换, documentation, product details.

ContextMenu.signature: ContextMenu(triggerLabel?: string, label?: string, items?: {label: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive", separator?: boolean, inset?: boolean}[], className?: string)
ContextMenu.description: Right-click context menu. `items` are the menu rows (variant 'destructive' for dangerous, separator true for a divider). Shows the trigger area and an inline preview of the menu.

CtaBand.signature: CtaBand(heading?: string, subheading?: string, cta?: string, variant?: "primary" | "muted" | "card", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", watermark?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
CtaBand.description: CTA band: centered heading + subheading + button. Chrome: brutalist (inverted dark + slanted seam + uppercase), gradient (glow orbs), terminal (mono $ prompt).

Dialog.signature: Dialog(title: string, description?: string, children?: any[], footer?: any[], triggerLabel?: string, className?: string)
Dialog.description: Modal dialog. Shows a trigger button and opens centered content with title, description, body (children) and footer. Open by default in preview.

DonationBand.signature: DonationBand(heading?: string, subheading?: string, amounts?: string[], className?: string, design?: string)
DonationBand.description: Donation band: heading + preset amount buttons + custom amount input. For nonprofits, fundraising.

Drawer.signature: Drawer(title: string, description?: string, children?: any[], footer?: any[], direction?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left", triggerLabel?: string, className?: string)
Drawer.description: Drawer panel that slides from an edge (vaul). direction top|right|bottom|left. Has title, description, body (children) and footer. Open by default in preview.

DropdownMenu.signature: DropdownMenu(triggerLabel?: string, label?: string, items?: {label: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive", separator?: boolean, inset?: boolean}[], className?: string)
DropdownMenu.description: Button that opens a menu of actions. `items` are the menu rows (set variant 'destructive' for dangerous actions, separator true for a divider). Open by default for preview.

Empty.signature: Empty(title: string, description?: string, media?: any[], mediaVariant?: "default" | "icon", children?: any[], className?: string)
Empty.description: Empty-state placeholder with title, description, optional media icon slot and content (children) for an action.

EventSchedule.signature: EventSchedule(heading?: string, events?: {time: string, title: string, description?: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
EventSchedule.description: Event schedule: time + title + optional description rows. For agendas, schedules, lineups.

FaqAccordion.signature: FaqAccordion(heading?: string, items?: {question: string, answer: string}[], chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
FaqAccordion.description: FAQ accordion: collapsible question/answer pairs. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices), terminal (mono $ prompts).

FeatureList.signature: FeatureList(features?: {heading: string, description: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, watermark?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
FeatureList.description: Feature list: alternating left/right rows with image on one side and heading + text on the other. Chrome: editorial (serif + watermark + image caption bars + figure indices), hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices).

Field.signature: Field(label?: string, children?: any[], description?: string, error?: string, orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal" | "responsive", className?: string)
Field.description: Labelled form row wrapping one control (children) with optional description/error. orientation vertical (default), horizontal, or responsive.

FieldDivider.description: Horizontal separator between fields, with optional centered label text.

FieldSetGroup.signature: FieldSetGroup(legend?: string, children?: any[], description?: string, legendVariant?: "legend" | "label", className?: string)
FieldSetGroup.description: Fieldset grouping several Fields (children) under an optional legend. legend variant 'legend' (default) or 'label'.

Footer.signature: Footer(brand?: string, columns?: {title: string, links: string[]}[], social?: string[], className?: string, design?: string)
Footer.description: Footer: brand + multi-column links + optional social. Always last on page.

Grid.signature: Grid(children?: any[], cols?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4" | "5" | "6", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", className?: string)
Grid.description: Responsive grid container. `cols` is the column count at desktop width (collapses on mobile).

GroupedList.signature: GroupedList(heading?: string, subheading?: string, groups?: {name: string, items: {title: string, description?: string, price?: string}[]}[], className?: string, design?: string)
GroupedList.description: Grouped list: categorized items with group headers. Each item has title, optional description, optional price. For menus, service lists, etc.

HoverCard.signature: HoverCard(triggerLabel?: string, children?: any[], align?: "start" | "center" | "end", className?: string)
HoverCard.description: Card that appears when hovering a trigger. `triggerLabel` is the hover target; children fill the card. Open by default for preview.

Image.signature: Image(alt: string, src?: string, w?: number, h?: number, className?: string)
Image.description: Standalone image. `alt` describes the subject and drives automatic stock-photo resolution; pass an explicit `src` URL to bypass it. Rounded by default via className.

ImageGallery.signature: ImageGallery(heading?: string, images?: {alt: string, src?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
ImageGallery.description: Image gallery: grid of image tiles with alt text. Chrome: editorial (image-zoom hover + caption bar), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows). Optional heading above.

Input.signature: Input(placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "search" | "tel" | "url", defaultValue?: string, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Input.description: Single-line text input. Mirrors shadcn Input.

InputGroup.signature: InputGroup(placeholder?: string, multiline?: boolean, leadingText?: string, trailingText?: string, leadingAlign?: "inline-start" | "inline-end" | "block-start" | "block-end", trailingAlign?: "inline-start" | "inline-end" | "block-start" | "block-end", buttonLabel?: string, buttonSize?: "xs" | "sm" | "icon-xs" | "icon-sm", defaultValue?: string, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
InputGroup.description: Text input or textarea with optional leading/trailing addon text and an optional addon button. Use for search bars, prefixed inputs, etc.

InputOTP.signature: InputOTP(length?: number, defaultValue?: string, separated?: boolean, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
InputOTP.description: One-time-passcode input with `length` slots. Set `separated` to split into two groups with a divider. Mirrors shadcn InputOTP.

Item.signature: Item(title: string, description?: string, media?: any[], mediaVariant?: "default" | "icon" | "image", actions?: any[], variant?: "default" | "outline" | "muted", size?: "default" | "sm", className?: string)
Item.description: List row with title, optional description, optional leading media slot and trailing actions slot. variant default|outline|muted, size default|sm.

ItemList.signature: ItemList(children?: any[], separated?: boolean, className?: string)
ItemList.description: Vertical list grouping several Item rows (children). Set separated for dividers between rows.

Kbd.description: Keyboard key cap, e.g. label '⌘' or 'Esc'.

KbdCombo.description: Row of keyboard key caps forming a shortcut, e.g. keys ['⌘','K'].

Label.signature: Label(text: string, htmlFor?: string, className?: string)
Label.description: Form field label. Mirrors shadcn Label.

LogoStrip.signature: LogoStrip(heading?: string, logos?: string[], className?: string, design?: string)
LogoStrip.description: Logo strip: horizontal row of brand names or logos for social proof. Optional heading.

LogosMarquee.signature: LogosMarquee(logos?: string[], className?: string, design?: string)
LogosMarquee.description: Logos marquee: scrolling strip of brand names. Animated social proof.

MapBlock.signature: MapBlock(heading?: string, address?: string, hours?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
MapBlock.description: Map block: heading + address/location info. Placeholder map area.

MediaSplit.signature: MediaSplit(heading?: string, text?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, reversed?: boolean, variant?: "split" | "story", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
MediaSplit.description: Media split: image on one side, heading + text on the other. Chrome: editorial (serif + image caption bar + figure index), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows).

Menubar.signature: Menubar(menus?: {label: string, items: {label: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive", shortcut?: string, separator?: boolean, inset?: boolean}[]}[], className?: string)
Menubar.description: Horizontal application menu bar. `menus` are top-level menus, each with `items` (variant 'destructive', separator true for a divider, optional shortcut text). First menu opens by default for preview.

NativeSelect.signature: NativeSelect(items: {value: string, label: string}[], placeholder?: string, defaultValue?: string, size?: "sm" | "default", disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
NativeSelect.description: Native dropdown select. `items` is an array of { value, label }. Mirrors shadcn NativeSelect.

Navbar.signature: Navbar(brand?: string, links?: string[], cta?: string, variant?: "default" | "centered" | "minimal" | "split", className?: string, design?: string)
Navbar.description: Navbar: brand name + nav links + optional CTA. Sticky top. variant: default|centered|minimal|split

NavigationMenu.signature: NavigationMenu(items?: {label: string, href?: string, links?: {label: string, href?: string, description?: string}[]}[], className?: string)
NavigationMenu.description: Top navigation menu. Each `items` entry is a top-level label; entries with `links` show a labelled list of links (with optional descriptions) inline beneath them.

NewsletterCta.signature: NewsletterCta(heading?: string, subheading?: string, cta?: string, variant?: "default" | "primary-tint" | "muted" | "inverted", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", watermark?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
NewsletterCta.description: Newsletter CTA: heading + email signup form. Chrome: terminal (mono $ prompt + inline capture), brutalist (inverted dark + rotated sticker + uppercase), editorial (serif + watermark). For newsletter, waitlist, subscribe sections.

NumberedList.signature: NumberedList(heading?: string, subheading?: string, steps?: {title: string, description?: string}[], chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
NumberedList.description: Numbered list: sequential steps with index, title, and description. Chrome: terminal (terminal window chrome + $ prompts + ghost numerals + exit 0), hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows).

PageSwitch.signature: PageSwitch(routes: string[], pages: any[], className?: string, pageIds?: string[])
PageSwitch.description: INTERNAL site router — do not select this directly. Renders one page at a time, switched by the shared $page state.

Pagination.signature: Pagination(pages?: string[], activePage?: string, ellipsis?: boolean, showPrevious?: boolean, showNext?: boolean, className?: string)
Pagination.description: Page navigation control with previous/next, numbered page links and an optional trailing ellipsis.

PersonGrid.signature: PersonGrid(heading?: string, people?: {name: string, role?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", className?: string, design?: string)
PersonGrid.description: Person grid: cards with photo, name, and role. For team, attorneys, chefs, etc.

Popover.signature: Popover(triggerLabel?: string, title?: string, description?: string, children?: any[], align?: "start" | "center" | "end", className?: string)
Popover.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger button. `triggerLabel` labels the button; title/description/children fill the panel. Open by default for preview.

PosterHero.signature: PosterHero(heading?: string, subheading?: string, cta?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
PosterHero.description: Full-bleed poster hero: giant display heading over a background image with minimal copy and a single CTA. Cinematic, bold.

PricingTable.signature: PricingTable(heading?: string, subheading?: string, tiers?: {name: string, price: string, features: string[], cta?: string, highlighted?: boolean}[], chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, watermark?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
PricingTable.description: Pricing table: tiered pricing cards with name, price, features list, and CTA. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border comparison strip), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows + rotated sticker), terminal (mono $ labels + inverted highlighted tier).

ProductDetail.signature: ProductDetail(title?: string, price?: string, comparePrice?: string, rating?: number, reviewCount?: number, description?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, variants?: string[], primaryCta?: string, specs?: {label: string, value: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
ProductDetail.description: Product detail page: large product image + buy box with title, price, rating, description, variant selector, and add-to-cart CTA. Below: specs grid and related products. For ecommerce product pages.

ProductGrid.signature: ProductGrid(heading?: string, products?: {name: string, price: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, className?: string, design?: string)
ProductGrid.description: Product grid: cards with image, name, price, and optional rating. For stores, shops, ecommerce.

ProjectGallery.signature: ProjectGallery(heading?: string, projects?: {title: string, category?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
ProjectGallery.description: Project gallery: grid of project cards with image, title, and optional category. For portfolios, work showcases.

QuoteBand.signature: QuoteBand(quote?: string, author?: string, role?: string, variant?: "default" | "gradient" | "muted", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", watermark?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
QuoteBand.description: Quote band: large centered pull quote with optional author. Chrome: brutalist (inverted dark + slanted seam + watermark), editorial (serif + watermark), gradient (glow orbs).

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(items: {value: string, label: string}[], defaultValue?: string, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
RadioGroup.description: Single-select radio list. `items` is an array of { value, label }. Mirrors shadcn RadioGroup.

Resizable.signature: Resizable(panels?: {content?: any[], defaultSize?: number}[], orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical", withHandle?: boolean, className?: string)
Resizable.description: Resizable split panels with draggable handles between them. Each panel in `panels` holds child content.

ScrollArea.description: Fixed-height scrollable container with a styled scrollbar. Put overflowing content in children.

SearchBar.signature: SearchBar(heading?: string, placeholder?: string, filters?: string[], className?: string, design?: string)
SearchBar.description: Search bar: heading + search input + optional filter chips. For directories, job boards, marketplaces.

Section.description: Page section with vertical padding and a centered max-width container. Use for top-level page bands.

SectionAnchor.signature: SectionAnchor(id: string, children: any, className?: string)
SectionAnchor.description: INTERNAL section anchor — do not select this directly. Wraps a generated section with a stable scroll target.

Select.signature: Select(items?: {value: string, label: string}[], placeholder?: string, defaultValue?: string, size?: "sm" | "default", className?: string)
Select.description: Dropdown select. `items` are the options; `placeholder` is shown when nothing is chosen. Opens by default for preview.

Sheet.signature: Sheet(title: string, description?: string, children?: any[], footer?: any[], side?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left", triggerLabel?: string, className?: string)
Sheet.description: Side panel that slides in from an edge. side top|right|bottom|left. Has a title, description, body (children) and footer. Open by default in preview.

SidebarNav.signature: SidebarNav(heading?: string, groups?: {label: string, items: string[]}[], contentTitle?: string, contentBody?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
SidebarNav.description: Sidebar navigation: fixed left sidebar with grouped nav links + main content area. For docs sites, dashboards, admin panels, knowledge bases, and content-heavy apps with deep navigation.

SignIn.description: A REAL working sign-in button wired to the site's Shoo/lakebed auth — shows 'Sign in' for guests and an account menu with Sign out when authenticated. Use anywhere a site needs real login (nav CTA, hero, account area). NOT a dummy/page-switch button.

SimpleList.signature: SimpleList(heading?: string, items?: {title: string, description?: string, price?: string, meta?: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
SimpleList.description: Simple list: flat rows of items with title, optional description, optional meta. For job boards, event lists, article lists.

Skeleton.description: Pulsing loading placeholder block. Size/shape it with className, e.g. 'h-4 w-32' or 'size-12 rounded-full'.

Slider.signature: Slider(defaultValue?: number, min?: number, max?: number, step?: number, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Slider.description: Range slider. Single-thumb by default. Mirrors shadcn Slider.

Spinner.description: Animated loading spinner. Size/color with className, e.g. 'size-8 text-primary'.

SplitHero.signature: SplitHero(badge?: string, heading?: string, highlight?: string, subheading?: string, primaryCta?: string, secondaryCta?: string, stats?: {value: string, label: string}[], watermark?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string, variant?: "split" | "default" | "full-bleed" | "gradient", chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", index?: string, decor?: "none" | "dot-grid" | "graph-paper" | "glow", className?: string, design?: string)
SplitHero.description: Asymmetric 7/5 split hero: mono badge + display heading with highlighted phrase + lead text + dual CTAs + collapsed-border KPI strip. Chrome: hairline (graph paper + collapsed-border KPIs + tick bars), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows + uppercase), gradient (glow orbs + pulsing dots), terminal (mono labels + dashboard panel + spark bars).

Stack.signature: Stack(children?: any[], direction?: "col" | "row", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around", wrap?: boolean, className?: string)
Stack.description: Flex container. The required root of every UI. direction 'col' (default) stacks vertically, 'row' horizontally.

StateButton.signature: StateButton(label: string, field: string, op?: "increment" | "decrement" | "set" | "toggle" | "reset", amount?: number, value?: number | string | boolean, initial?: number | string | boolean, variant?: "default" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "destructive", className?: string)
StateButton.description: A button that MUTATES a named shared state field on click — op is increment | decrement | set | toggle | reset. This is REAL interactivity (not a navigation link): use it with StateText to build counters, steppers, toggles and any click-driven state. `field` is the state key; `amount` is the step for increment/decrement (default 1); `value` is the target for set; `initial` seeds/resets the field.

StateInput.signature: StateInput(field: string, placeholder?: string, initial?: string, className?: string)
StateInput.description: A text input two-way bound to a named shared state field — typing updates the field live and any StateText reading the same field reflects it. Use `field` as the state key. Composes into forms, search boxes, todo entry, any input-driven state.

StateText.signature: StateText(field: string, initial?: number | string | boolean, prefix?: string, suffix?: string, className?: string)
StateText.description: Live text bound to a named shared state field — displays the CURRENT value of that field and updates instantly when it changes. Use the `field` string as the state key and `initial` to seed it. Pair with StateButton/StateInput to build any stateful UI (counter readouts, running totals, toggle labels). NOT a static label.

StatsStrip.signature: StatsStrip(heading?: string, stats?: {value: string, label: string, sparkBars?: number[]}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial" | "gradient", index?: string, watermark?: string, decor?: "none" | "dot-grid" | "graph-paper" | "glow", className?: string, design?: string)
StatsStrip.description: Stats strip: KPI cells with large numerals and mono labels. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + tick bars), brutalist (inverted dark band + slanted seam), terminal (mono $ labels + spark bars).

StepProcess.signature: StepProcess(heading?: string, steps?: {title: string, description?: string}[], className?: string, design?: string)
StepProcess.description: Step process: numbered steps with connecting line. For onboarding, workflows, processes.

SvelteIsland.signature: SvelteIsland(html: string, script?: string, css?: string)
SvelteIsland.description: Renders a server-compiled Svelte 4 component. SSR HTML is injected directly; DOM JS is loaded client-side for interactivity. Used when no existing section component matches a role and the LLM generated a custom Svelte component.

Switch.signature: Switch(label?: string, size?: "sm" | "default", defaultChecked?: boolean, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Switch.description: On/off toggle switch with optional inline label. Mirrors shadcn Switch.

Table.signature: Table(columns?: {key: string, label: string}[], rows?: Record<string, string>[], caption?: string, className?: string)
Table.description: Data table. `columns` define headers (key+label); each `rows` object maps column key -> cell text. Optional caption.

Tabs.signature: Tabs(items: {value: string, label: string, content?: any[]}[], variant?: "default" | "line", className?: string)
Tabs.description: Tabbed panels. items:[{value,label,content?}]. First tab active by default. variant 'line' for underlined tabs.

TeamShowcase.signature: TeamShowcase(heading?: string, people?: {name: string, role?: string, bio?: string, imageAlt?: string, imageSrc?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", className?: string, design?: string)
TeamShowcase.description: Team showcase: larger person cards with photo, name, role, and bio. More detail than personGrid.

TestimonialRow.signature: TestimonialRow(heading?: string, testimonials?: {quote: string, author: string, role?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
TestimonialRow.description: Testimonial row: grid of quote cards with author name and optional role. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows + rotated stickers).

Text.description: Paragraph / body text. tone 'muted' for secondary text.

Textarea.signature: Textarea(placeholder?: string, defaultValue?: string, rows?: number, disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Textarea.description: Multi-line text input. Mirrors shadcn Textarea.

Timeline.signature: Timeline(heading?: string, events?: {date: string, title: string, description?: string}[], chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
Timeline.description: Timeline: vertical sequence of events with date, title, and description. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono dates), terminal (mono $ prompts + ghost numerals).

Toggle.signature: Toggle(label: string, pressed?: boolean, variant?: "default" | "outline", size?: "default" | "sm" | "lg", disabled?: boolean, className?: string)
Toggle.description: Two-state on/off button. Mirrors shadcn toggle variant/size.

ToggleGroup.signature: ToggleGroup(items: {value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean}[], type?: "single" | "multiple", defaultValue?: string, variant?: "default" | "outline", size?: "default" | "sm" | "lg", className?: string)
ToggleGroup.description: Set of toggle buttons. items:[{value,label}]. type 'single' (one active) or 'multiple'. variant/size mirror Toggle.

Tooltip.signature: Tooltip(content: string, triggerLabel?: string, side?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left", className?: string)
Tooltip.description: Small floating label attached to a trigger. `content` is the tooltip text; `triggerLabel` labels the trigger button. Open by default for preview.

ValueProps.signature: ValueProps(heading?: string, values?: {title: string, description?: string}[], cols?: number, chrome?: "none" | "hairline" | "brutalist" | "terminal" | "editorial", index?: string, className?: string, design?: string)
ValueProps.description: Value props: grid of value propositions with title and description. Chrome: hairline (collapsed-border + mono indices + tick bars), terminal (mono $ labels), brutalist (border-2 + hard shadows).
